final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT sc.invoice_count FROM state_counts sc CROSS JOIN totals t WHERE sc.invoice_count > t.avg_count) SELECT SUM(a.invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * a.invoice_count / t.total_invoices) AS average_share, AVG(a.invoice_count - t.avg_count) AS average_invoices_above_average FROM above_avg a CROSS JOIN totals t
